mapper.sql: SELECT c.id, c.cert_no, c.user_id, c.promotion_id, c.template_url, c.status, c.generate_time, c.create_time, u.nick_name AS user_name FROM certificate c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = c.user_id AND u.del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO certificate (cert_no, user_id, promotion_id, template_url, status, generate_time, create_time) VALUES (#{certNo}, #{userId}, #{promotionId}, #{templateUrl}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.status = 'GENERATED' ORDER BY c.generate_time DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT 1
WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.generate_time DESC, c.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM certificate WHERE cert_no = #{certNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE certificate SET status = 'REVOKED' WHERE promotion_id = #{promotionId} AND status = 'GENERATED'
UPDATE certificate SET status = 'REVOKED' WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'GENERATED'
